reviews.author: Himanshu
reviews.title: Product golan is good
reviews.body: Very good service and easily install in my metal door,

reviews.author: Surbhi Jain
reviews.title: Keeps on Hanging and then doesn't work
reviews.body: I bought it because of the features it mentioned. But it is a disappointment. Almost never works from phone. Lock keeps on getting hanged. Almost never working properly Poor quality. Zero value for money. Installation was difficult. Didn't even survive few weeks so poor durability.

reviews.author: Melvin Almeida
reviews.title: Value for money Product
reviews.body: Very nice product, value for money, easy to use & configure.

reviews.author: John
reviews.title: Good product, excellent support
reviews.body: Exactly the product I was looking for small, functional with WiFi, temp password, rfid, finger prints etc. multiple modes to open the lock including temporary entry, extremely convenient. I have a den which I only occasionally use, for personal use and my friends who visit once in a while. Moreover I bought this on Jan 02nd 26 and called for installation on 20th, it was immediately taken up. Very happy with the product.

reviews.author: Ghosh
reviews.title: Good smart lock also works for double door.
reviews.body: Good product. App needs some improvement , specially if you have multiple products.
